  `g.logprobs[-1]` — the distribution at the FINAL emitted token, which
  for clean greedy completions is `<|im_end|>` (id 248046). That IS the
  post-response slot for any completion that ended naturally without ever
  emitting the marker. For completions that DID emit the marker mid-
  response (e.g. an internal ` ※` somewhere), the rank-at-last-step still
  reflects "rank of marker at the slot the model chose im_end" which is
  the relevant comparison for the install-validity claim. A stricter
  reading would identify the position of the trailing ` ※` (if present)
  + assess rank at the slot BEFORE it — that adds parser complexity for a
  case where `ended_with_marker=True` already tells the same story.
  Plan §4.6(b) phrases the diagnostic as "argmax-rank-of-marker at the
  post-response slot"; the current read matches that.
